details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15733-15743 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The poller G3 hook `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update "${final_pr}" "${pr_head_sha}" "${default_branch}" "${REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW:-ci.yml}" blocked_status || true` uses `ci.yml` only as the argument fallback and never sets the global `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW`, so after the update-branch PUT and the marker post, `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2024-2027) returns `skipped reason=workflow_unset` and dispatches no final CI, while the helper still logs `outcome=updated reason=ci_wiring_behind`.
  WHY: The update head gets no final CI run from this path, and later poller ticks log `current final_ci_no_run` and do nothing, which contradicts the documented "update, then the update head's final CI". All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes the impact: the synchronize review's marker fast path and the `deterministic-skip-merge` job dispatch the final CI with `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW` set (review_autofix.yml:141), so the PR loses one cycle rather than stalling. minimax notes the same exposure for the `_pr_sync_merge_blocked_guard` hook at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:861.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2506-2534 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`'s refused-update path, only a literal `mergeable: true` counts as transient, so a failed `pulls/<pr>` read (empty JSON from the `|| echo ""` fallback) or `mergeable: null` falls through to the unconditional `<!-- ai:final-ci-wiring-behind:v1 ... reason=update_branch_refused -->` marker POST.
  WHY: One transient read failure, or a read taken while mergeability is still pending, permanently holds the head: every later call finds the marker through `_pr_final_ci_wiring_note_seen` and returns `held recorded`, which contradicts the code's own comment and the sibling `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` (lines 2049-2061), which polls again on `null`. Severity disagreement: minimax rated its separate `mergeable=null` item (line 2520) NIT; every other report was MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2485-2522 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_gate "${wiring_pr}" "${wiring_base}" "${wiring_head}" update` (line 2494) runs before the refused-update read, and the `held update_branch_failed` / `held head_moved` returns record no marker and release no lease, so every sweep or review tick re-acquires or renews the base's update lease and PUTs `update-branch` again.
  WHY: Other PRs on the same base wait with `MERGE_LEASE_REASON=held` for as long as the refusal lasts; minimax puts the bound at up to `MERGE_LEASE_MAX_HOLD_MINUTES=720`. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT; minimax and luna rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2494-2523 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The refused-update handling mixes persistent refusal, transient failure and lease handling, so retry decisions based on stale PR reads ("already moved" / "mergeable") could cause tight retry loops.
  WHY: This could lead to excessive API calls and branch-update attempts if it is not carefully gated.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2410-2418 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When the freshness side channel has `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_PATHS="__truncated__"` (a compare of 300+ files), `wiring_tip` is taken from an empty `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_SHA` (line 2417), and the shadowed local at line 2504 passes an empty base SHA to `_pr_base_sync_observe_update_commit`, which fails with `base_tip_unknown` (line 1885).
  WHY: The update PUT moves the head, but no `ai:merge-base-sync:v1` marker is posted and no final CI is dispatched, so the update head runs a full reviewer round and the merge is delayed one cycle. Both reporters rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it: `PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_BASE_SHA` is set at lines 1611-1614, before the truncation branch at line 1628.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:multiple lines | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate on commit df0cdb288f23350dee0e955f4acd14d093f4e251 reports `Failures caused by this change: 1 — shellcheck`, and the previous editor ran only `bash -n`.
  WHY: A red lint gate blocks CI. Severity disagreement: gemini rated it BLOCKER, minimax NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says the failure cannot be mapped to a file:line (CI runs `shellcheck --severity=error`, ci.yml:663, and check-runs report `failed_count: 0`), and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes the same disagreement between the gate and CI.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G1/G2: "Before the pipeline dispatches a final CI run for a PR, it checks whether the head's ci.yml ... differs from the base branch's because the branch is behind", and "the pipeline does not dispatch the final CI on the stale workflow."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:137, :186; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_ensure_final_ci` skip guard (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1207)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The auto-merge-off and e2e-smoke-test exits set `PR_FINAL_CI_WIRING_SKIP=true` at scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:137,186, `_pr_ensure_final_ci` skips the wiring check when the flag is set (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1207) and still dispatches on the head ref, so a head whose ci.yml is behind gets a final CI from its stale workflow copy; sonnet suggests running the check and holding without updating.
- requirement: G4: "The check costs no extra API call per PR per tick in the common case. Compare blob SHAs from data the caller already has, or from one cached read of the base's workflow blob SHAs per cycle."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340 (candidate processing); scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The sweep calls `_pr_ensure_final_ci "${REPOSITORY}" "${number}" "${sha}" "${ref}"` per candidate at scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh:340 with no base ref and no freshness side channel, so each call reads the PR (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:1215-1217) and runs its own compare (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2421-2422), and the sweep has no per-cycle base workflow SHA cache.
- requirement: "A switch (default on) that restores today's behaviour."
  expected_change_site: The `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW` and poller environment mappings in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The helper reads `FINAL_CI_WIRING_BEHIND_UPDATE_ENABLED` from its process environment, but neither workflow maps a repository variable into it, so setting the documented switch as a repository variable does not disable the behaviour.
- requirement: G2: "When the branch cannot be updated (conflict, lease held by another PR, update refused), the pipeline ... records one clear reason on the PR and in the log."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` refused-update handling (mergeable: true return)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: When the refresh reports `mergeable: true`, the helper returns at lines 2520-2522 without posting a PR comment, the only record is the log reason `update_branch_failed`, and because the lease was acquired the lease-wait label is not applied either.
- requirement: G2: "When the branch cannot be updated ... the pipeline does not dispatch the final CI on the stale workflow. It records one clear reason on the PR and in the log, and the PR waits like any other PR that needs a branch update."
  expected_change_site: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update`, the post-refusal PR read at lines 2512-2522
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: A transient `pulls/<pr>` read failure (empty JSON) is misclassified as a confirmed refusal and falls through to the persistent marker POST with no read-failure check (cross-listed with the CORRECTNESS finding).
- requirement: The PR acceptance table lists `check | lint | not run`, and the pre-push gate on commit df0cdb28 reports shellcheck as a failure caused by this change.
  expected_change_site: the shellcheck violation (file:line not pinned; changed regions scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2296-2560, scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15736-15744, scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh:134-190)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: There is no shellcheck-clean run on record for this head, the editor ran only `bash -n`, and CI check-runs show failed_count: 0, which disagrees with the pre-push gate.
- requirement: "Also run `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py` and `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py`." The acceptance table lists `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py` as "unmet".
  expected_change_site: Acceptance criteria verification
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The pre-push gate lists this test as failing ("Inherited failures"). It may be inherited, but it must be resolved or explicitly ignored for the final CI to pass.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 15740-15743 (chain: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` lines 2024-2027, `_pr_ensure_final_ci` lines 1143-1151) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The poller hook falls back to `ci.yml` only for the argument; nothing in the poller sets the global `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW` (only review_autofix.yml:141 and review_autofix_sweep.yml:953 do), so the update runs and the marker is posted, but `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_FINAL_CI outcome=skipped reason=workflow_unset` dispatches nothing, while the helper still logs `outcome=updated`.
  WHY: The new head has no final CI, later ticks log `current final_ci_no_run`, and the PR waits for another job to dispatch it. Suggested fix: prefix the call with `REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW="${REVIEW_FINAL_CI_WORKFLOW:-ci.yml}"`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_pr_final_ci_wiring_behind_update` refused-update branch (about lines 2512-2529) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only a literal `mergeable: true` counts as transient; a failed or unreadable read (empty values) and `mergeable: null` (stringified as "null") both fall through to the permanent `reason=update_branch_refused` marker, unlike `_pr_base_sync_dispatch_final_ci` (lines 2049-2061).
  WHY: The head is permanently held with `held recorded`, the update is never retried and the final CI is never dispatched. Suggested fix: post the marker only when `wiring_after_mergeable` is exactly `false`.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate ... update` (line 2494), then the `held update_branch_failed` / `held head_moved` returns | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A persistent refusal with `mergeable: true` re-acquires or renews the update lease (holder write at lines 4061-4073) and re-PUTs `update-branch` on every tick without releasing the lease, the same no-release shape as the freshness path (lines 2106-2134).
  WHY: Other PRs on the same base wait with `MERGE_LEASE_REASON=held` for as long as the refusal lasts, bounded only by the lease TTL that eac
